jobs.title: On-Demand Finance Lead - HQ
jobs.description:
Glovo is part of the Delivery Hero Group, the world’s pioneering local delivery platform, our mission is to deliver an amazing experience—fast, easy, and to your door. We operate in around 65 countries worldwide. Headquartered in Berlin, Germany. Delivery Hero has been listed on the Frankfurt Stock Exchange since 2017 and is part of the MDAX stock market index.

Job Ref ID: JR0085366

YOUR MISSION

Glovo launched Glovo On-Demand in 2022, a B2B vertical empowering partners to power their own delivery channels using our world-class logistics network across 10+ countries. As On-demand Finance Lead, you will be the end-to-end owner of the vertical’s financial performance, operations, and growth strategy. Operating with high visibility and autonomy, you will steer P&L performance, architect automated Order-to-Cash (O2C) processes, and partner with Product & Tech to build next-generation Fintech products that scale our business sustainably.

THE JOURNEY

-
Financial Performance & P&L Ownership: Own and steer the end-to-end On-Demand P&L across revenue and cost levers. Build scenario models, evaluate expansion opportunities, and execute targeted cost-reduction initiatives (e.g., operational fee optimization).

-
Financial Operations & O2C Architecture: Design and optimize scalable Order-to-Cash (O2C) workflows—ensuring timely, error-free partner invoicing and driving zero-debt operational targets alongside Financial Systems and GBS teams.

-
Fintech Product & AI Innovation: Partner directly with Product and Engineering to build On-Demand Fintech features, while identifying opportunities to automate financial workflows through modern AI and tooling.

-
Commercial & Pricing Strategy: Collaborate with commercial teams to establish dynamic pricing strategies, define commercial guidelines, and support complex contract negotiations.

-
Team Leadership: Act as day-to-day manager and coach for 2 Finance Analysts, driving execution, setting performance goals, and supporting their professional development.
jobs.requirements_raw:
WHAT YOU WILL BRING TO THE RIDE

Experience & Background

-
5+ years of experience in Strategic Finance, Financial Operations, Commercial Finance, Strategy Consulting (e.g., MBB), or CFO-track roles within fast-paced tech or marketplace environments.

-
Full P&L Ownership & Modeling: Proven track record managing P&L economics, unit economics, and driving structured cost-reduction or growth strategies.

-
Proven Problem Solving: Ability to structure complex, ambiguous problems and arrive at data-driven solutions using hypothesis-led approaches.

-
Executive Presence & Stakeholder Management: Exceptional communication skills with a track record of partnering with cross-functional leadership (Commercial, Ops, Product, GBS).

-
Fluent English (written and spoken).

Skills & Leadership Competencies

-
Financial Operations Expertise: Background or solid familiarity with Order-to-Cash (O2C), invoicing systems, and finance operational processes.

-
Data & SQL Fluency: Working knowledge of SQL (or strong desire to build hands-on querying skills) to extract insights, troubleshoot data discrepancies, and build models independently.

-
People Management Experience: Prior experience managing, mentoring, or functionally leading junior analysts or cross-functional team members.

-
B2B Pricing & Commercial Strategy: Experience building or evaluating dynamic/fixed pricing structures and commercial contract frameworks.

-
Process Automation & AI Curiosity: Interest or experience in leveraging automation tools or AI applications to streamline repetitive operational tasks.

jobs.title: Senior Fullstack Software Engineer (Kotlin/Java/React) - Fintech
jobs.description:
As the world’s pioneering local delivery platform, our mission is to deliver an amazing experience, fast, easy, and to your door. We operate in around 65 countries worldwide, powered by tech, designed by people. As one of Europe’s largest tech platforms, headquartered in Berlin, Germany, Delivery Hero has been listed on the Frankfurt Stock Exchange since 2017 and is part of the MDAX stock market index. We push hard, learn quickly and stay human along the way. It’s this wonderful mix of high performance and real community that makes Delivery Hero a place where ambition and belonging grow side by side. If you’re curious, collaborative and ready to dive deep into meaningful work, you’ll fit right in.

We are on the lookout for a Senior Fullstack Software Engineer (Kotlin/Java/React) to join our Fintech team and build worldwide innovative Wallet, Payment, and Anti-Fraud solutions with us. Work and scale our internal Payments engine that would handle payments for the entire Delivery Hero. If you're a creative problem solver who is eager to deliver solutions and hungry for a new adventure, an international workplace is waiting for you in the heart of Berlin!

Be part of building the financial backbone of Delivery Hero. You’ll develop products that empower millions of customers and merchants, from seamless payments to innovative financial solutions like wallets and credit.

- Design, build, and deliver highly scalable software systems operating in complex, global business environments, used across more than 70 countries

- Lead backend and frontend engineering efforts with a strong focus on distributed systems, leveraging Java, Kotlin, modern frameworks such as Spring / Spring Boot, Hibernate, and JUnit and frontend technologies such as React / TanStack.

- Own services end-to-end by embracing a true “you build it, you run it” mindset, with deep involvement in infrastructure automation and continuous deployment.

- Drive high-quality software design by systematically applying design patterns, SOLID principles, and Domain-Driven Design (DDD).

- Build secure, resilient systems by applying secure coding best practices throughout the development lifecycle.

- Influence engineering culture through hands-on leadership, technical mentorship, and continuous improvement.
jobs.requirements_raw:
- Proven experience designing and delivering software systems in highly complex business domains at global scale, within fintech /payments.

- Deep backend engineering expertise with a strong preference for distributed systems.

- Hands-on mastery of Java, Kotlin, Spring / Spring Boot, Hibernate, and JUnit.

- Strong hands-on experience with TypeScript and React and PostgreSQL.

- A strong engineering ownership mindset with a passion for automation, CI/CD, and reliability.

jobs.title: Manager, Retail Media Projects & Performance
jobs.description:
foodpanda is part of the Delivery Hero Group, the world’s pioneering local delivery platform, our mission is to deliver an amazing experience—fast, easy, and to your door. We operate in around 65 countries worldwide. Headquartered in Berlin, Germany. Delivery Hero has been listed on the Frankfurt Stock Exchange since 2017 and is part of the MDAX stock market index.

We are looking for a Retail Media Projects & Performance Manager to join our Regional Retail Media team in Singapore.

The role will support the growth and performance of our Retail Media business across APAC & EU by combining performance management, market acceleration and project execution.

Working closely with regional and local Retail Media teams, you will help track business performance, identify opportunities and risks, coordinate improvement actions, and support the implementation of key regional initiatives across markets.

You will also manage selected Retail Media projects, helping translate regional priorities into clear plans and ensuring effective coordination between markets and cross-functional teams.

This role is ideal for someone who is analytical, structured and execution-oriented, and who enjoys working across multiple markets and stakeholders to turn business priorities into tangible results.

Key Responsibilities

1. Performance Management & Insights

- Track Retail Media performance across APAC & EU markets against targets and key business KPIs.

- Support regular regional performance reviews by consolidating insights, highlighting key drivers and identifying required actions.

- Work with market teams to understand performance gaps and follow up on agreed improvement actions.

- Support forecasting and business planning processes with relevant analysis and market inputs.

- Develop clear and actionable performance reporting for regional and local stakeholders.

2. Market Acceleration

- Support selected markets in identifying opportunities to accelerate Retail Media revenue and improve commercial performance.

- Conduct deep dives into specific markets, customers or revenue streams to understand underlying performance drivers.

- Work with local teams to translate findings into practical acceleration plans and track progress against agreed actions.

- Identify successful initiatives and ways of working across markets and support their replication in other relevant markets.

- Provide additional coordination and analytical support to markets during key commercial periods or strategic initiatives.

3. Retail Media Projects

- Manage selected regional Retail Media projects from planning through implementation.

- Translate project objectives into clear workplans, milestones, responsibilities and success metrics.

- Coordinate activities across Retail Media, Commercial, Product, Marketing, Operations and other relevant teams.

- Track project progress, dependencies and risks, escalating blockers where required.

- Support pilots and new initiatives across selected markets, capturing results and learnings to inform potential regional rollout.

- Ensure project outcomes and learnings are documented and shared across the Retail Media organisation.

4. Commercial & Business Analysis

- Analyse revenue performance across advertisers, categories, markets and Retail Media solutions.

- Identify potential opportunities to increase advertiser investment and adoption of Retail Media products.

- Support business cases and opportunity sizing for new initiatives.

- Provide data and insights to support regional commercial priorities and market discussions.

- Help establish benchmarks that allow markets to compare performance and identify areas for improvement.

5. Ways of Working & Best Practice

- Support the development of common processes, templates and tools for Retail Media performance management and project execution.

- Identify opportunities to simplify recurring processes and improve visibility across markets.

- Document and share best practices, case studies and learnings from successful market initiatives.

- Facilitate collaboration and knowledge sharing between local Retail Media teams.

- Help ensure regional initiatives are consistently implemented and tracked across participating markets.

Success in this role means helping regional and local teams turn insights and priorities into consistent execution. You will contribute to:

- Improved visibility of Retail Media performance across markets.

- Faster identification and follow-up of performance gaps and opportunities.

- Effective execution of regional Retail Media projects.

- Stronger adoption of successful initiatives and best practices across markets.

- Clearer coordination between regional and local teams.

- More consistent performance management and ways of working across APAC.
jobs.requirements_raw:
- 4–6 years of experience in business performance, project management, commercial strategy, e-commerce, digital advertising, Retail Media or a related field.

- Strong analytical skills and confidence working with commercial and performance data.

- Experience coordinating projects involving multiple stakeholders.

- Ability to translate analysis into clear actions and recommendations.

- Strong organisational and project management skills, with the ability to manage multiple priorities simultaneously.

- Commercial mindset and interest in understanding the drivers behind business performance.

- Strong communication and stakeholder management skills.

- Comfortable working independently while collaborating across teams and markets.

- Hands-on and execution-oriented approach to problem solving.

- Experience in regional or multi-market environments is an advantage.

- Experience in Retail Media, advertising, marketplaces or e-commerce is a plus.

jobs.title: Sr Software Engineer IOS
jobs.description:
PedidosYa forma parte de Delivery Hero, empresa líder mundial en servicios de delivery con presencia en ~65 países. PedidosYa es la empresa de tecnología líder en delivery y quick-commerce en Latinoamérica. Es una plataforma simple, rápida y accesible que conecta a millones de personas usuarias, empresas y repartidores con una amplia variedad de productos y servicios. PedidosYa opera en 15 países en latinoamérica, y en 2020 lanzó PedidosYa Markets, el primer mercado 100% digital que entrega alimentos y artículos para el hogar en 15 minutos. Delivery Hero cotiza en la Bolsa de Frankfurt desde 2017 y forma parte del índice bursátil MDAX.

Tenemos una oportunidad para vos, estamos buscando Sr Software Engineer iOS para el equipo de Home QC dentro de Quick Commerce.

-
Liderar la evolución técnica y la optimización continua de la Home de Quick Commerce, construyendo una arquitectura modular y flexible que permita adaptar la pantalla dinámicamente a las necesidades específicas de cada persona usuaria.

-
Implementar interfaces nativas (UI) complejas y de alto rendimiento que destaquen a nuestros partners, asegurando una navegación impecable (smooth scrolling, animaciones fluidas, renderizado eficiente) para maximizar el tráfico cross-funnel y facilitar la conversión.

-
Garantizar la salud y escalabilidad del código iOS de nuestro dominio, promoviendo activamente las mejores prácticas de ingeniería, testing automatizado y el uso de patrones de diseño modernos.

-
Colaborar estrechamente con los equipos de Producto, Diseño (UX/UI) y Backend para analizar la viabilidad técnica y transformar los objetivos de negocio en soluciones móviles robustas y de primer nivel.

-
Actuar como un referente técnico en el equipo, participando activamente en code reviews, proponiendo mejoras arquitectónicas y promoviendo una cultura de excelencia técnica y ownership sobre el producto entregado.
jobs.requirements_raw:
-
Sólida experiencia en desarrollo nativo con iOS (Swift, UIKit), dominio en la integración de servicios REST y aplicación rigurosa de principios SOLID y patrones de diseño.

-
Conocimientos avanzados en arquitecturas escalables, modularización de aplicaciones complejas y gestión eficiente de frameworks y dependencias.

-
Experiencia comprobable implementando pruebas automatizadas (TDD, Unit Tests) y autonomía en el manejo de herramientas de CI/CD (como Fastlane y Jenkins) para asegurar integraciones y entregas continuas de alta calidad.

-
Conocimiento e interés en Inteligencia Artificial, con capacidad para integrar flujos de IA agéntica (Agentic AI), ya sea para potenciar la hiper-personalización de la Home, resolver problemas complejos o eficientizar los propios procesos de desarrollo.

-
Fuerte capacidad de colaboración cross-equipo, con experiencia trabajando de forma transversal con otros squads dentro del mismo dominio (Quick Commerce), alineando soluciones técnicas, compartiendo contexto y evitando silos de información.

-
Curiosidad técnica y visión de producto, con proactividad para proponer mejoras e innovaciones que eleven sostenidamente la disponibilidad, la fluidez y el rendimiento (performance) de la plataforma.

-
Nivel de inglés oral intermedio-avanzado , necesario para interactuar fluidamente y desenvolverte en un entorno de trabajo dinámico.

jobs.title: Senior Data Engineer - (Fintech Data)
jobs.description:
As the world’s pioneering local delivery platform, our mission is to deliver an amazing experience, fast, easy, and to your door. We operate in around 65 countries worldwide, powered by tech, designed by people. As one of Europe’s largest tech platforms, headquartered in Berlin, Germany, Delivery Hero has been listed on the Frankfurt Stock Exchange since 2017 and is part of the MDAX stock market index. We push hard, learn quickly and stay human along the way. It’s this wonderful mix of high performance and real community that makes Delivery Hero a place where ambition and belonging grow side by side. If you’re curious, collaborative and ready to dive deep into meaningful work, you’ll fit right in.

We are on the lookout for a Senior Data Engineer (Fintech) to help build the next-generation data foundation for fraud prevention.

Be part of building the financial backbone of Delivery Hero. You’ll develop products that empower millions of customers and merchants, from seamless payments to innovative financial solutions like wallets and credit. Your work will support our path to profitability by creating financial flexibility for users and enabling smooth transactions across our markets.

Our Flink-based streaming platform already powers real-time fraud signals. In this role, you will build and enhance historization capabilities, batch pipelines, data quality framework, and observability tooling to make fraud data reliable, traceable, and easy to use for rule evaluation, model training, inference, and backtesting.

You will work closely with Data Science and Engineering teams and own the full lifecycle of these data solutions, from design and development to operation and continuous improvement.

-
Build accurate, point-in-time-correct datasets for model training, backtesting, and analysis.

-
Design and build scalable batch pipelines that complement our existing Flink-based streaming platform.

-
Develop robust controls for data completeness, freshness, anomaly detection, reconciliation, and business-logic accuracy.

-
Build observability capabilities that surface pipeline failures, data drift, and quality issues before they affect downstream models or fraud rules.

-
Partner with Data Scientists and Fraud Ops to translate fraud-prevention use cases into scalable, resilient data products while maintaining consistency between batch and real-time processing.
jobs.requirements_raw:
Cloud Data Engineering: experience building production data pipelines using Python, Airflow, dbt, and BigQuery on GCP or AWS.

-
Stream Processing: hands-on experience with Apache Flink or a similar framework, including event time, state, checkpointing, and late-arriving data.

-
Data Science Enablement: a strong understanding of feature preparation, model training, backtesting, and inference workflows.

-
Data Quality and Observability: experience building validation frameworks, monitoring, alerting, and data lineage for production systems.

-
Engineering Ownership: a track record of owning data solutions from design and implementation through deployment and operations.

jobs.title: Senior Manager - Infrastructure Security
jobs.description:
As the world’s pioneering local delivery platform, our mission is to deliver an amazing experience, fast, easy, and to your door. We operate in around 65 countries worldwide powered by tech, designed by people. As one of Europe’s largest tech platforms, headquartered in Berlin, Germany. We enable creative minds to deliver solutions that create impact within our ecosystem. We move fast, take action and adapt. No matter where you're from or what you believe in, we build, we deliver, we lead. We are Delivery Hero.

We are on the lookout for a Senior Manager, Infrastructure Security. In this pivotal role, you will lead the strategy for protecting our cloud and corporate environments by reducing real-world risk without slowing down the business. You will champion a "Secure by Design" philosophy, ensuring that security is a collaborative engineering challenge where automated guardrails and technical excellence enable our platform to scale rapidly and securely by default.

As a Senior Manager, you will build and lead a mission-oriented team of engineers, fostering a culture where technical excellence, automation, and professional growth are central to our operations. You will move away from reactive auditing, instead focusing on the engineering of non-negotiable technical gates that prevent misconfiguration at the source. Your leadership will be defined by the ability to co-design the "how" with Engineering and IT, co-authoring architectural blueprints that are technically viable and operationally frictionless. By driving the transition toward Security-as-Code and consistent enforcement across 100% of our assets, you will directly influence the resilience and velocity of the world’s leading local delivery platform.

- Lead and Mentor a High-Performing Team: Champion a culture of technical excellence and professional growth, enabling the team to drive strategic infrastructure resilience and long-term career success.

- Drive Infrastructure Security Maturity: Define the strategic roadmap for our core domains to ensure maximum risk reduction and operational efficiency across our global cloud and corporate infrastructure.

- Engineering Ownership and Enablement: Partner with tech verticals to provide the tooling, visibility, and expertise required for Engineering to own their security outcomes.

- Automate Preventive Guardrails: Replace reactive manual checkpoints with automated policy-as-code and admission controls to validate or reject changes before they reach production.

- Standardize Global Security Baselines: Eliminate ad-hoc configurations by architecting unified, version controlled security standards across our entire cloud and corporate infrastructure.

- Drive Vulnerability Governance: Architect scalable processes and automation to identify, prioritize, and remediate infrastructure risks, ensuring a measurable reduction in our attack surface.
jobs.requirements_raw:
- Proven Engineering Leadership: You have a track record of building and leading high performing engineering teams in complex global environments.

- Cloud Security Expertise: You possess deep technical knowledge of AWS and GCP security architectures including identity boundaries, network isolation, and resource hardening.

- Security as Code Mindset: You are proficient in driving automation through Terraform, CloudFormation, or similar infrastructure as code tools to enforce security standards.

- Modern Preventive Controls: You have experience implementing admission controllers and policy engines such as OPA, Gatekeeper, or Kyverno to automate production guardrails.

- Strategic Risk Management: You can translate complex technical vulnerabilities into clear business risks and prioritize remediation efforts based on actual threat impact.

- Collaborative Influence: You are an expert at partnering with SRE, DevOps, and Platform Engineering teams to co-design security solutions that enhance rather than hinder developer velocity.

- Operational Excellence: You have experience architecting vulnerability management programs that leverage automation to handle patching and configuration drift at a massive scale.

Nice to have:

- Large Scale Cloud Operations: Experience managing security consistency across a complex, multi-account environment within both AWS and GCP.

- Security Compliance: Familiarity with implementing technical controls to meet industry standards such as SOC2, ISO 27001, or PCI DSS.

- Advanced Certifications: Professional level credentials such as the AWS Security Specialty, Google Professional Cloud Security Engineer, or CISSP.

jobs.title: Service Delivery Lead for Georgia & Armenia
Senior Data Scientist - (Content, Consumer)
jobs.description:
As the world’s pioneering local delivery platform, our mission is to deliver an amazing experience, fast, easy, and to your door. We operate in around 65 countries worldwide powered by tech, designed by people. As one of Europe’s largest tech platforms, headquartered in Berlin, Germany. Delivery Hero has been listed on the Frankfurt Stock Exchange since 2017 and is part of the MDAX stock market index. We enable creative minds to deliver solutions that create impact within our ecosystem. We move fast, take action and adapt. No matter where you're from or what you believe in, we build, we deliver, we lead. We are Delivery Hero.

We are on the lookout for a Senior Data Scientist to join our Content tribe.

We are building the ratings and reviews systems — social proof — that shape how millions of people decide what to order, across dozens of markets and languages. It is a greenfield space: the current system is early, and the interesting decisions have not been made yet.

The raw material is the hard kind. Millions of short, noisy, multilingual, contradictory pieces of user-generated text, which have to become something a person can act on in two seconds on a restaurant page. Getting that right is an LLM systems problem: aspect extraction, sentiment, summarisation, model selection across providers, systematic prompt optimisation, and the evaluation infrastructure that tells you whether any change made things better.

We are honest about the situation. The team is rebuilding ownership of these systems during a transition, and a lot is undefined. That is the offer: you will not inherit a technical direction; you will set it — and you will set the LLM bar for a team with the appetite and the room to clear it.

Why is this one different?

-
You define the direction. Architecture, model strategy, evaluation approach — these are open questions, and they become yours.

-
You are the LLM authority for the squad, not a contributor to someone else's. Part of the job is raising everyone else's ceiling.

-
Real scale, real consequence. Your models move conversion across Delivery Hero's global platforms.

-
Genuinely unsolved problems. Multilingual UGC at scale, empirical multi-provider model selection, prompt optimisation, and evaluation infrastructure for generative output — none of these have a settled answer here or anywhere.

-
Agentic development is a first-class part of how we work, used pragmatically to move faster without losing system understanding.

Your Mission

-
You'll own the LLM systems behind social proof end-to-end — quality, reliability, and coverage across languages, platforms, and use cases — including the unglamorous parts: drift, miscalibration, silent quality degradation, and data issues in production.

-
You'll set the standard for how this team builds with LLMs. Model and provider selection based on empirical cost, latency, and quality evidence. Prompt strategy that is systematic rather than folkloric. The judgment on when an LLM is the wrong tool.

-
You'll drive the roadmap through problem discovery, finding high-impact gaps, quantifying the business value, and turning them into scoped initiatives — treating cost of inference as a product decision, not only an engineering constraint.

-
You'll define and operationalise meaningful metrics, and build the evaluation infrastructure behind them — offline eval suites, LLM-as-judge frameworks, and annotation processes — so that evaluation reflects true business value rather than misleading proxies, and a prompt change or model swap becomes a one-day decision.

-
You'll take prototypes to production, shaping architecture and data flows with backend and data engineering, and building the feedback loops that let the system keep improving without constant manual intervention.

-
You'll raise the bar beyond your own work, through best practices, mentoring, and a culture of ownership and pragmatism.
jobs.requirements_raw:
-
NLP & LLM systems depth. You have built LLM-based systems that reached production, preferably on noisy, multilingual, user-generated text. You can explain the architecture, the failure modes you hit, and why you made the calls you made. You have worked across more than one model family and more than one architecture, and you can reason empirically about cost, latency, and quality rather than defaulting to a familiar vendor or pattern. You know when to prompt, when to add context or retrieval, when to fine-tune, when a small task-specific model wins, and when not to use an LLM at all.

-
Evaluation rigour for generative systems. You know an online A/B test is too slow and too blunt to iterate an LLM system on. You have designed offline evaluation suites, used LLM-as-judge patterns while being honest about their biases, structured annotation for generative outputs, and measured faithfulness, hallucination, and quality at scale.

-
Observability for LLM pipelines. You instrument what you build: tracing chained calls, watching token usage and cost, and capturing intermediate outputs so a multi-step pipeline can actually be debugged. You have a view on where this is non-negotiable and where it is overhead.

-
Product thinking and problem framing. You turn an ambiguous business need into a well-scoped DS problem, spot the high-impact opportunity nobody put on the roadmap, and connect your technical work to outcomes people outside data science care about.

-
Ambiguity and an MVP instinct. You move from zero to one on imperfect information, ship in increments, and resist over-engineering.

-
Leverage beyond yourself. You improve how the people around you work — practices, standards, rigour — and you are the reason a team gets better at something, not just faster at it.

Also valuable

-
Production-grade Python and analytical SQL, with familiarity with ML lifecycle practices, orchestration, monitoring, and modern engineering standards such as version control and CI/CD.

-
A strong foundation in statistics and causal inference, and the instinct to challenge a result that looks too good.

-
Experience with data collection and labelling pipelines, including working with annotation teams.

-
Agentic development tools used pragmatically — including applying them to model improvement itself, such as automated prompt optimisation or LLM-assisted annotation — with the judgment to know when to verify the output.

jobs.title: Senior Specialist, Rider Payments
jobs.description:
foodpanda is part of the Delivery Hero Group, the world’s pioneering local delivery platform, our mission is to deliver an amazing experience—fast, easy, and to your door. We operate in around 65 countries worldwide. Headquartered in Berlin, Germany. Delivery Hero has been listed on the Frankfurt Stock Exchange since 2017 and is part of the MDAX stock market index.

We are seeking a highly analytical and results-driven individual to join our regional logistics team as a Senior Specialist, Performance (Courier Pricing).

In this role, you will play a critical part in designing, analyzing, and optimizing rider payment and incentive strategies across our 16 diverse markets. Acting as the bridge between high-level business goals and on-the-ground operational reality, you will treat rider incentives as a key operational lever. You will use data-driven insights to improve rider earnings, enhance fleet satisfaction, and drive overall logistics performance while ensuring financial sustainability.

Key Responsibilities:

- Incentive Strategy & Governance: Define and optimize rider payment and incentive models. Develop frameworks to harmonize incentive strategies across diverse markets while allowing for necessary local adaptations, maintaining consistency and financial discipline. Ensure payment models align with broader business goals, logistics performance KPIs (e.g., delivery time), and rider satisfaction.

- Financial Impact & Cost Efficiency: Continuously evaluate the financial impact of payment models and monitor cost-per-order (CPO) trends. Ensure incentive structures align with broader profitability targets while maintaining sufficient rider supply and fleet retention.

- Data Analysis & Insights: Dive deep into large datasets to identify trends, inefficiencies, and areas for improvement in rider payments and logistics operations. Translate complex data into actionable strategic recommendations.

- Rollout of Models & Automation: Execute and drive the regional implementation of advanced data science models and automated tools tailored to rider payments and operational efficiency.

- Initiative Rollout & Innovation: Challenge the status quo by introducing innovative techniques to enhance rider payment systems. Support the testing and rollout of strategic initiatives and new pay components (e.g., dynamic pricing, surge models, quest incentives) aimed at improving logistics performance and order acceptance rates.

- Product Collaboration: Partner with the Delivery Hero’s Central Product team to influence the development of payment-related features. You will translate business requirements into product requests, participate in testing, and ensure the successful adoption of new product capabilities across the region.

- Stakeholder Management & Market Partnership: Work closely with operations, finance, product, and local logistics stakeholders. Build strong relationships with market teams to understand their unique challenges, implement refined incentive structures, and drive scalable solutions.
jobs.requirements_raw:
- Experience: 3+ years of professional experience in high-growth tech, logistics, strategy consulting, or investment banking. Experience specifically in the gig-economy, marketplace dynamics, or logistics is a strong plus.

- Education: University degree in STEM, Economics, Business, or a related quantitative field.

- Technical Fluency: Proficiency in Excel, SQL, and Looker is required to independently dive into the data, uncover insights, and build robust models.

- Communication: Exceptional English communication skills, both written and spoken. You are comfortable effectively challenging the status quo, and negotiating with senior stakeholders and leadership.

jobs.title: Lead, CRM MarTech
jobs.description:
foodpanda is part of the Delivery Hero Group, the world’s pioneering local delivery platform, our mission is to deliver an amazing experience—fast, easy, and to your door. We operate in around 65 countries worldwide. Headquartered in Berlin, Germany. Delivery Hero has been listed on the Frankfurt Stock Exchange since 2017 and is part of the MDAX stock market index.

We are searching for a highly motivated and technically strong CRM specialist to join our CRM MarTech team. This role is focused on the technical side of CRM execution - building, debugging, and improving how our CRM communications work behind the scenes. You will work on CRM setups across multiple markets, dealing with large scale and complexity.

You will act as a key bridge between CRM and our technical ecosystem, working extensively within Braze to implement advanced personalisation, integrate data sources, and ensure our setups are scalable and reliable. A key part of the role is also exploring new platform capabilities and identifying smarter, more automated ways of working.

This is not a pure campaign management role. It is designed for someone who enjoys working with logic, APIs, data flows, and maintaining scalable CRM systems, and wants to deepen their expertise in the CRM MarTech domain over time.

What You Will Do

Technical Execution & Personalisation

Build and maintain CRM campaigns and lifecycle flows in Braze, with a strong focus on Liquid logic, dynamic content, and scalable setups. Leverage APIs and Connected Content to power personalised user experiences to maximize the business impact on the platform

Platform Ownership (Braze)

Act as a key technical user of Braze, supporting the wider CRM team in implementing new features, testing capabilities, and improving how we use the platform. Stay up to date with new releases and identify opportunities to push beyond standard use cases.

Infrastructure & Data Collaboration

Work closely with Product and Data teams to ensure CRM data is reliable and usable. Support the setup and improvement of data flows, integrations, and event tracking that power CRM communications. Contribute to making our overall CRM architecture more scalable over time.

Debugging, QA & Reliability

Troubleshoot technical issues across campaigns and flows, including Liquid logic errors, API failures, and data inconsistencies. Maintain a high standard of accuracy and reliability across all executions.

Optimisation & Continuous Improvement

Support experimentation and iteration by ensuring campaigns are set up correctly for testing. Proactively identify inefficiencies in current workflows and suggest more automated or scalable approaches. Explore how AI tools can support areas such as QA, content generation, or workflow automation in a practical and controlled way.

Team Leadership & Capability Building

Lead, mentor, and upskill a high-performing team of CRM MarTech specialists. Define technical standards, establish robust QA workflows, and build an environment of operational excellence to support the team’s growth and delivery across multiple markets.
jobs.requirements_raw:

- 5–8+ years of experience in CRM, Martech, or a similar technical marketing role, ideally within B2C or fast-paced digital businesses

- Hands-on experience with Braze is highly preferred

Technical Competencies

- Strong working knowledge of Liquid (or similar templating languages), with the ability to handle complex personalisation logic

- Comfortable with basic HTML/CSS and familiar with APIs (REST/JSON), including how to work with payloads and external data

- Knowledge of SQL is a plus

- Comfortable working with Product and Data teams to define technical and business requirements for data feeds, events, and integrations. You don’t need to build backend systems, but should understand how CRM connects to the wider tech stack

- Data driven with a good grasp of growth and campaign analytics such as conversion uplift, engagement metrics, ROI

- Proven experience managing, mentoring, and developing direct reports in a technical marketing or MarTech setting, with a track record of building high-performing teams and fostering operational excellence

Technical & Soft Skills

- Detail-oriented, data driven and structured, with a strong focus on clean and reliable CRM execution in Braze

- Curious about how systems work, with a proactive approach to improving existing setups and workflows

- Obsessed about operational excellence

- Strong understanding of how MarTech infrastructure directly impacts core business drivers (e.g., CAC, LTV, order frequency, and retention). Able to translate complex technical setups into tangible business outcomes and prioritize engineering effort based on ROI and strategic impact

- Interest in AI, with a willingness to experiment with tools that enhance efficiency, automation, and quality

- Comfortable navigating ambiguity and working cross-functionally with Product, Data, and Marketing teams

jobs.title: Senior Account Manager Retail - Montenegro (They/She/He)
jobs.description:
Glovo is part of the Delivery Hero Group, the world’s pioneering local delivery platform, our mission is to deliver an amazing experience—fast, easy, and to your door. We operate in around 65 countries worldwide. Headquartered in Berlin, Germany. Delivery Hero has been listed on the Frankfurt Stock Exchange since 2017 and is part of the MDAX stock market index.

If you’re here, it’s because you’re looking for an exciting ride.

A ride that will fuel up your ambitions to take on a new challenge and stretch yourself beyond your comfort zone.

We’ll deliver a non-vanilla culture built on talent, where we work to amplify the impact on millions of people, paving the way forward together.

Not your usual app. We are the fastest-growing multi-category app connecting millions of users with businesses, and couriers, offering on-demand services from more than 170,000 local restaurants, grocers and supermarkets, and high street retail stores. We operate in more than 1500 cities across 23 countries.

Together we revolutionize the way people connect with their everyday needs, from delivering essentials to connecting our ecosystem of users through innovative solutions powered by technology. For us, every day is filled with purpose.

What makes our ride unique?

🤝 Our strong culture and non-vanilla personality.

💪 A Talent House.

🤝 Our commitment to being a force for good.

We have a vision: To give everyone easy access to anything in their cities. Our vision is ambitious, for that we need driven talent! And this is where your ride starts…

YOUR MISSION

As a Senior Retail Account Manager, you don’t just manage accounts, you own our most significant strategic relationships. Your goal is to scale our retail footprint at maximum velocity while fostering long-term partnerships. By securing best in class content and driving performance, you will directly enhance the user experience. Your mission is to ensure our partners land on the platform with a bang and stay optimized for maximum growth. You will be the bridge between Glovo and our retail partners, ensuring every operational detail is perfect and every growth opportunity is captured.

We need a ‘Retail Ambassador’: someone who is deeply hands-on, obsessed with data, and thrives in the ‘fast lane’. We are looking for a high-energy ‘doer’. Someone who is obsessed with details, loves solving puzzles with data, and isn't afraid to get their hands dirty to make things happen. You’ll be joining a fast-paced ride where your learning curve will be vertical.

THE JOURNEY

- Own the Joint Business Plan (JBP) for top partners, defining the year roadmap to boost GMV and market share.

- Build and scale a high-impact partner portfolio, identifying untapped business opportunities and creative collaborations.

- Act as the primary POC from day one, leading negotiations and onboarding new accounts to ensure a ‘win-win’ ecosystem.

- Manage a portfolio of accounts, acting as their go-to contact for daily operations and performance improvements.

- Maintain a professional, proactive, and HIGH BAR relationship with our partners, representing our brand in every interaction.

- Dive into the data to spot issues (like high cancellation rates or slow prep times) and work directly with partners to fix them - you like challenges!

- Take charge of bringing new partners onto the platform, ensuring their digital storefronts are set up for day-one success.

- Drive onboarding excellence: Streamlining partner setup through precise city coverage, catalogue synchronization, and operational rigor to guarantee long-term success - mastery in execution!

- Maintain high-level engagement through monthly and quarterly business reviews, becoming a trusted advisor to stakeholders.

- Navigate a high-task environment with ease, turning complex multidisciplinary problems into elegant, scalable solutions.
jobs.requirements_raw:
WHAT YOU WILL BRING TO THE RIDE

- Relationship Management: 2+ years of experience managing robust, long-term partnerships. You know how to drive account success and ensure our company remains top-of-mind for your partners.

- The Owner’s Mindset: You have a natural bias for action. You don’t wait for permission to make things happen; you drive results and hit deadlines.

- Analytical Power: You are comfortable with complex data sets, using them to back up your business judgments and strategy.

- Customer-Centric Mindset: You enjoy building relationships and helping others succeed. You are patient, clear, and persuasive in your communication.

- Retail Expertise: Thorough understanding of retail P&L, revenue dynamics, and the drivers that move the needle in the digital marketplace.

- Communication: Exceptional English proficiency and the ability to command a room, whether you're presenting to internal teams or external partners.

- Negotiation Prowess: Proven track record of managing large-scale accounts and negotiating commercial terms that drive value.

- Adaptability: You thrive in "controlled chaos". You can switch between tasks quickly without losing your focus on quality.

- Retail Passion: You have a genuine interest in how the retail and delivery industry works.

- Experience: 2+ years of experience (internships count!) in sales, account management, or operations.

Individuals representing diverse profiles, and abilities, encompassing various genders, ethnicities, and backgrounds, are less likely to apply for this role if they do not possess solid experience in 100% of these areas. Even if it seems you don't meet our musts don't let it stop you, we are all about finding the best talent out there! Skills can be learned, and embracing diversity is invaluable.

We believe driven talent deserves:

🌟 An enticing equity plan that lets you own a piece of the action.

💪 Private health insurance to keep you at your best.

🍔 Monthly Glovo credit to fuel your cravings.

🏊 Discounted gym memberships to stay active.

🧠 Access to online therapy and wellbeing programs to support your mental health.

🏖️ The freedom to work from home two days a week, and the opportunity to work from anywhere for up to three weeks a year and personal days off.

👪 Enhanced parental leave.

Here at Glovo, we thrive on diversity, we believe it enhances our teams, products, and culture. We know that the best ideas come from a mashup of brilliant diverse minds. This is why we are committed to providing equal opportunities to talent from all backgrounds - all genders, racial/diverse backgrounds, abilities, ages, sexual orientations and all other unique characteristics that make you YOU. We will encourage you to bring your authentic self to work, fostering an inclusive environment where everyone feels heard.

Feel free to note your pronouns in your application (e.g., she/her/hers, he/him/his, they/them/theirs, etc).

So, ready to take the wheel and make this the ride of your life?

Delve into our culture by taking a peek at our Instagram and check out our Linkedin and website!

jobs.title: Demand Planner Uganda
jobs.description:
Glovo is part of the Delivery Hero Group, the world’s pioneering local delivery platform, our mission is to deliver an amazing experience—fast, easy, and to your door. We operate in around 65 countries worldwide. Headquartered in Berlin, Germany. Delivery Hero has been listed on the Frankfurt Stock Exchange since 2017 and is part of the MDAX stock market index.

YOUR MISSION

In the context of “giving users easy access to anything in their city”, Q-commerce (Quick Commerce) is the business unit that aims to provide immediacy to all product needs that a user might have, from delivering a video game to sending a gift... to filling up their fridge. We do that through 3 verticals: Groceries with Partners, Groceries with our own Micro Fulfillment Centers (MFCs), and Retail Shops.

As part of the MFCs Vertical team, the Demand Planner is a crucial position in our structure: accurately forecasting future product needs and strategically placing purchase orders with vendors is key to effectively replenishing our stores, meeting customer needs while minimizing food waste.

THE JOURNEY

-
Improve forecast accuracy by utilizing historical sales data to adjust demand forecasts for promotions, seasonal variations, special events and new products, among others.

-
Work closely with category management, marketing and operations teams to gather relevant information for aligning demand forecasts with supply chain capabilities.

-
Maintain and adjust purchasing tool parameters (safety stocks, bank holidays,…) to ensure inventory optimization.

-
Be responsible for the supply planning and replenishment of our MFCs, by creating purchase orders and monitoring supplier delivery

-
Enhance performance of suppliers (fill rates, no shows, delays, incidents) by facilitating communication, addressing concerns and working collaboratively with them to establish improvement plans.

-
Monitor and report Supply Chain Key Performance Indicators (KPIs) of your country.

-
Analyze and interpret data (availability, inventory levels, turnover, shrinkage, fill rates…) to identify trends, potential risks and opportunities for improvement.

-
Drive action plans to achieve operational excellence in the supply chain by optimizing processes, reducing costs, improving efficiency and enhancing overall performance.
jobs.requirements_raw:
WHAT YOU BRING TO THE RIDE

-
Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Business, Finance or a Supply Chain / Operations discipline.

-
Two years of relevant experience in Supply Chain, preferably focused on Demand or Supply Planning

-
Must possess excellent business judgment, strong written and oral communication skills, and a practical, common sense approach to getting things done.

-
Ability to analyze and interpret data and use critical thinking skills on a regular basis is key.

-
Proficiency in Google Applications.

-
Fluent in English

jobs.title: Coordinator Environmental Health & Safety - Distribution Center
Shift Supervisor
jobs.description:
PedidosYa forma parte de Delivery Hero, empresa líder mundial en servicios de delivery con presencia en ~65 países. PedidosYa es la empresa de tecnología líder en delivery y quick-commerce en Latinoamérica. Es una plataforma simple, rápida y accesible que conecta a millones de personas usuarias, empresas y repartidores con una amplia variedad de productos y servicios. PedidosYa opera en 15 países en latinoamérica, y en 2020 lanzó PedidosYa Markets, el primer mercado 100% digital que entrega alimentos y artículos para el hogar en 15 minutos. Delivery Hero cotiza en la Bolsa de Frankfurt desde 2017 y forma parte del índice bursátil MDAX.

Tenemos una oportunidad para vos, estamos buscando Shift Supervisor en Mar del Plata.

- Asegurar la correcta operación (proceso de picking) de la tienda durante su turno, manteniendo altos estándares de Calidad, en concordancia con los Procesos y Políticas de la Compañía.

-Coordinar el equipo y sus tareas, asignando recursos según prioridades y maximizando la productividad. Solucionando conflictos que puedan darse en su turno de trabajo.

-Asegura el staff adecuado por día y horario, estando en constante comunicación con el Store Manager, respecto de la performance del equipo.

-Monitorea performance del equipo y da soporte al Store Manager en el cumplimiento de los procesos administrativos de la tienda. (Gestión de inventarios/Control de Merma/Facturación/People/Mantenimiento).

-Garantiza que la tienda cumpla con las políticas regionales y locales de seguridad alimentaria, Salud ocupacional y Medioambiente. Es el encargado de reportar todos los desvios que puedan surgir en la tienda en relación a las politicas.

-Da soporte al Store Manager en el Monitoreo las tareas en la tienda, en el desarrollo profesional de las personas y sugiere mejoras para aumentar la productividad.

- En ausencia del Store Manager es el encargado de coordinar los turnos de trabajo y de disponer la modalidad de trabajo en la tienda.

-Controla y gestiona la organización el area de recepcion y despacho. Despeja el espacio y deja listos los equipos necesarios.

-En ausencia del Store Manager, supervisara todo el proceso de recepcion y respondera como responsable. Reporta a su lider ante un eventual conflicto con un proveedor.

-Es el responsable de delegar con un picker o realizar la Recepción de la mecadería controlando el camión, los SKUs y cantidades. Controla vencimientos y calidad de productos que recibe (interidad de los productos, temperaturas en refrigerados y congelados). Ante la ausencia del Store Manager, rechaza productos que inclumplen nuestros estandares y procedimientos establecidos.

- Es el responsable de delegar o realizar el ingreso de la mercadería, repone en estanterías y equipos de frio. Cumpliendo los estándares de orden, seguridad, calidad e higiene. Siendo asi un referente para su equipo.

- Asegura la correcta capacitacion de su dotación de acuerdo a estandares y politicas de la compañia ( ej: proceso de Onboarding/Offboarding). Velando por la excelencia operativa.

- Impulsar iniciativas para mejorar el clima y la motivación de los empleados en la tienda. Organizando rituales, comunicando novedades e integrando la cultura PeYa en el día a día de la tienda.

- Utiliza sistemas como, Tableau, Ops Portal, Workday, Gmail, Orquest y Pelican, para la planificación y ejecución de procedimientos administrativos. - Analiza las metricas del negocio fomentando la excelencia operativa y productividad en la tienda.

-Es responsable por la integridad de su inventario y por alcanzar los targets de Accuracy establecidos

-Planifica y coordina junto al Store Manager los conteos ciclicos.

-Realiza o delega con Pickers los conteos planificados respetando los procedimientos para ayudar a mantener los inventarios en linea

Experiencia en puestos similares liderando equipos de trabajo.

Conocimientos de herramientas paquete Office (Excel, Word, Powerpoint) y Google.

-
Orientación a la acción y capacidad para resolver problemas.

-
Fuertes habilidades interpersonales; capacidad para construir relaciones positivas, generar confianza. Autonomía.

Construir y escalar la plataforma de datos de Growth: Liderar la arquitectura y el desarrollo de pipelines robustos y escalables, optimizando los procesos de ETL/ELT.

-

Velar por la salud del código: Asegurar la disponibilidad, escalabilidad y mantenibilidad de la plataforma.

-

GCP o servicios de datos en la nube.

Inglés conversacional.

Python.

jobs.title: Lead Financial Business Partner – On-Demand
jobs.description:
Glovo is part of the Delivery Hero Group, the world’s pioneering local delivery platform, our mission is to deliver an amazing experience—fast, easy, and to your door. We operate in around 65 countries worldwide. Headquartered in Berlin, Germany. Delivery Hero has been listed on the Frankfurt Stock Exchange since 2017 and is part of the MDAX stock market index.

Job Ref ID: JR0085366

YOUR MISSION

Glovo launched Glovo On-Demand in 2022, a B2B vertical empowering partners to power their own delivery channels using our world-class logistics network across 10+ countries. As On-demand Finance Lead, you will be the end-to-end owner of the vertical’s financial performance, operations, and growth strategy. Operating with high visibility and autonomy, you will steer P&L performance, architect automated Order-to-Cash (O2C) processes, and partner with Product & Tech to build next-generation Fintech products that scale our business sustainably.

THE JOURNEY

-
Financial Performance & P&L Ownership: Own and steer the end-to-end On-Demand P&L across revenue and cost levers. Build scenario models, evaluate expansion opportunities, and execute targeted cost-reduction initiatives (e.g., operational fee optimization).

-
Financial Operations & O2C Architecture: Design and optimize scalable Order-to-Cash (O2C) workflows—ensuring timely, error-free partner invoicing and driving zero-debt operational targets alongside Financial Systems and GBS teams.

-
Fintech Product & AI Innovation: Partner directly with Product and Engineering to build On-Demand Fintech features, while identifying opportunities to automate financial workflows through modern AI and tooling.

-
Commercial & Pricing Strategy: Collaborate with commercial teams to establish dynamic pricing strategies, define commercial guidelines, and support complex contract negotiations.

-
Team Leadership: Act as day-to-day manager and coach for 2 Finance Analysts, driving execution, setting performance goals, and supporting their professional development.
jobs.requirements_raw:
WHAT YOU WILL BRING TO THE RIDE

Experience & Background

-
5+ years of experience in Strategic Finance, Financial Operations, Commercial Finance, Strategy Consulting (e.g., MBB), or CFO-track roles within fast-paced tech or marketplace environments.

-
Full P&L Ownership & Modeling: Proven track record managing P&L economics, unit economics, and driving structured cost-reduction or growth strategies.

-
Proven Problem Solving: Ability to structure complex, ambiguous problems and arrive at data-driven solutions using hypothesis-led approaches.

-
Executive Presence & Stakeholder Management: Exceptional communication skills with a track record of partnering with cross-functional leadership (Commercial, Ops, Product, GBS).

-
Fluent English (written and spoken).

Skills & Leadership Competencies

-
Financial Operations Expertise: Background or solid familiarity with Order-to-Cash (O2C), invoicing systems, and finance operational processes.

-
Data & SQL Fluency: Working knowledge of SQL (or strong desire to build hands-on querying skills) to extract insights, troubleshoot data discrepancies, and build models independently.

-
People Management Experience: Prior experience managing, mentoring, or functionally leading junior analysts or cross-functional team members.

-
B2B Pricing & Commercial Strategy: Experience building or evaluating dynamic/fixed pricing structures and commercial contract frameworks.

-
Process Automation & AI Curiosity: Interest or experience in leveraging automation tools or AI applications to streamline repetitive operational tasks.

jobs.description:
As the world’s pioneering local delivery platform, our mission is to deliver an amazing experience, fast, easy, and to your door. We operate in around 65 countries worldwide powered by tech, designed by people. As one of Europe’s largest tech platforms, headquartered in Berlin, Germany. Delivery Hero has been listed on the Frankfurt Stock Exchange since 2017 and is part of the MDAX stock market index. We enable creative minds to deliver solutions that create impact within our ecosystem. We move fast, take action and adapt. No matter where you're from or what you believe in, we build, we deliver, we lead. We are Delivery Hero.

We are on the lookout for a Senior Data Scientist - (Global Search, Consumer) to join the Search Ranking team within our Global Search tribe. If you thrive at the intersection of cutting-edge deep learning research and high-traffic production systems — and are excited about autonomous AI-driven experimentation — this role is for you.

Our search functionality spans more than 60 countries and 35 languages, facilitating over 80 million searches daily across four continents. The ranking systems you build will directly shape what millions of customers see every time they open the app.

Your mission:

- Own the Ranking Stack End-to-End: Design, build, and productionalize deep neural ranking models — including DCN-V2, MMoE, and Two-Tower architectures — operating at high throughput and low latency in production. You will own the full lifecycle: from offline experimentation and evaluation to monitoring, and iterative improvement.

- Drive Agentic ML Research: Embrace and champion the shift from manual experimentation to prompt-driven orchestration. You will leverage LLM coding agents (e.g., Claude Code, Gemini) to autonomously iterate on feature engineering and Learning to Rank (LTR) architectures. Inspired by the auto-research paradigm, you will design overnight experiment pipelines and review the outputs of hundreds of autonomous runs to identify signals quickly.

- Lead Feature Engineering and Model Architecture Innovation: Apply your deep expertise in ranking signals, feature stores, and embedding-based retrieval to push the quality of our rankers. Propose and validate new model architectures grounded in the latest research, translating academic advances into production-grade systems.

- Ensure Production Reliability: Maintain rigorous standards for model health in production. You will own monitoring for model drift, latency degradation, and feature pipeline integrity, and act quickly when signals deviate — keeping our ranking quality high for users across all markets.

- Collaborate Across Disciplines: Work as a technical partner with Backend Engineers, Data Engineers, and Product Managers to deliver end-to-end improvements. Translate complex ML trade-offs into clear narratives for non-technical stakeholders, and contribute to shaping the team's roadmap.

- Raise the Bar: Mentor junior and mid data scientists, drive best practices in experimentation rigor and code quality, and actively contribute to a culture of learning — especially around emerging agentic development workflows.
jobs.requirements_raw:
- Master's degree (or Bachelor's with 6+ years of work experience) in Computer Science, Mathematics, Physics, or a related quantitative field. 4+ years of industry experience as a Data Scientist or Machine Learning Engineer applying ML in high-traffic production environments.

- Deep Learning Ranking & LTR: Hands-on, production-proven experience implementing modern deep learning ranking architectures — DCN-V2, MMoE, Two-Tower — with strong command of multi-task learning, cross-feature interactions, and embedding optimization at scale. Solid foundation in LTR methods (pointwise, pairwise, listwise), offline evaluation metrics (NDCG, MRR), and the challenges of bridging offline metrics to online A/B outcomes.

- Agentic & AI-Assisted Development: Proficiency with LLM coding agents and agentic CLI tools (e.g., Claude Code, Gemini) as first-class tools in your development workflow — not just for boilerplate, but for autonomous experiment generation, architecture prototyping, and rapid iteration. Familiarity with the auto-research paradigm and comfort reviewing large volumes of autonomously generated experiment results.

- Technical Depth & MLOps: Expert in Python and its ML ecosystem (PyTorch, TensorFlow, scikit-learn). Comfortable with SQL (dbt), cloud environments (GCP or AWS), and big-data processing at scale (PySpark, Scala). Strong command of the full ML lifecycle — feature stores, vector databases, model versioning, A/B experimentation frameworks, and deployment to high-throughput, low-latency serving infrastructure. Hands-on experience with MLOps practices: CI/CD for ML pipelines, Metaflow, experiment tracking, model registry, and production monitoring covering drift detection, latency tracking, and data quality alerting.

- Problem-Solving & Ownership: Comfortable navigating ambiguity and translating broad business objectives into well-scoped data science projects. You hold yourself accountable for outcomes, not just outputs.

- Collaborative Spirit: Demonstrated ability to work effectively in cross-functional, globally distributed teams. Strong communication skills to articulate model behavior, experiment results, and trade-offs to both technical and non-technical audiences

jobs.description:
Glovo is part of the Delivery Hero Group, the world’s pioneering local delivery platform, our mission is to deliver an amazing experience—fast, easy, and to your door. We operate in around 65 countries worldwide. Headquartered in Berlin, Germany. Delivery Hero has been listed on the Frankfurt Stock Exchange since 2017 and is part of the MDAX stock market index.

YOUR MISSION

Rider cost is one of the largest cost lines at Glovo with more than 20 markets with very different economics. Your mission is to own business performance for our largest and most strategic markets, and to make sure the Controlling system behind them holds: that we see risks and opportunities early, that targets get challenged rather than accepted, and that analysis turns into decisions our markets actually execute. You will do this as a senior individual contributor with genuine decision ownership, your job is not to report on performance, but to drive it.

THE JOURNEY

-
Own rider business performance across our whole 20+ markets. You are the senior counterpart to Country Heads of Operations, Finance and General Managers in our largest markets, challenging their targets, deviations and recovery plans without formal authority .Across the rest of the portfolio, you will steer the overall picture, coaching and stepping in when an issue becomes material, ambiguous or cross-market

-
Own the 360° view of our rider business KPIs. Cost is the headline, but it is only one dimension. You will own the full performance picture for our rider operations, cost per order and budget delivery alongside utilisation, delivery times, reassignments, supply health and rider experience, and you will be the person who holds the trade-offs between them. A market that hits its cost target by quietly degrading service has not hit its target, and it will be your job to say so. Over time, you become the person in the company who understands this business best.

-
Find the money, and decide where we look for it. Across a portfolio this size there is always more to investigate than there is capacity to investigate it. You will identify the highest-value risks and opportunities, drawing on experiments, competitor benchmarks and market trends as much as on our own numbers, decide where the organisation spends its analytical effort, and take deep dives all the way through to a decision, always with ROI in mind.

-
Own material deviations end to end: root cause, accountable owner, recovery plan and follow-through to closure. The goal is that nothing material surfaces for the first time at month close.

-
Lead the business narrative through our Best Estimate, budget and annual planning cycles, owning the material trade-offs and the senior decisions, and acting as the single reference point for FP&A and Finance leadership rather than one voice among several. Where the returns justify it, you make the case for additional investment to Glovo's executive leadership, controlling the budget is only half the job.

-
Raise the standard of the Controlling system itself, the standards, definitions, cadence, tooling usage and accountability that determine whether performance management is trustworthy. You will own this globally and set the standard the whole function works to, with a Controlling colleague covering our small and medium markets working with you on a dotted line. There are no direct reports today; as the function grows, there is a credible path to building a team around this scope.

-
Be the business challenger to our analytics team, who own the forecasting, target-setting engine, models and performance tooling behind many of these decisions. You will need to understand their work well enough to find its weaknesses and make it better, without trying to own it yourself.

-
Turn performance into decisions for senior leadership, VPs, Glovo leadership, Corporate Strategy and Delivery Hero counterparts, through short, honest, decision-oriented communication.

-
4–7+ years in Business Performance, Controlling, Strategy & Operations, FP&A, Consulting, Marketplace or Operations, including at least one role where you carried real accountability for a budget, a cost line or a market portfolio, not advisory work alone.

-
A genuine ownership mentality, and comfort operating without direct reports. You find the problem, form your own view, drive the decision, and make sure execution actually follows.

-
A track record of challenging and influencing stakeholders more senior than you, and getting them to move.

-
Strong analytical problem solving. You can decompose a performance problem yourself, interrogate someone else's model, and do the maths rather than wait for it.

Comfort with ambiguity, and the judgement to tell signal from noise and focus on what is material.

-

-
Comfort using AI tools to accelerate your own analysis.

SQL or BI tools such as Looker at a confident user level, enough to answer your own first questions.

-
Financial fluency sufficient to hold your own with FP&A and Finance leadership on budgets, deviations and planning cycles.

Experience in marketplace, gig-economy, logistics or quick-commerce businesses.

Experience in a high-growth, multi-market or matrixed HQ-and-markets organisation.

Glovo is part of the Delivery Hero Group, the world’s pioneering local delivery platform, our mission is to deliver an amazing experience—fast, easy, and to your door. We operate in around 70 countries worldwide. Headquartered in Berlin, Germany. Delivery Hero has been listed on the Frankfurt Stock Exchange since 2017 and is part of the MDAX stock market index.

Glovo is looking for an Accountant in the Finance Department who will set-up and lead in-house accounting.

THE JOURNEY:

- Support daily accounting activities, including posting journal entries and maintaining accurate records.

- Responsible for complying with local requirements related to tax and accounting.

- Assist accounting team in preparing reconciliations and executing month-end, quarter-end, and year-end close activities.

- Support for preparation of Statutory financial statements.

- Follow the changes in company policy, tax regulations and legislation.

- Ensure all original documents (contracts, acts, VAT declarations, etc.) align with the company's best interests.

- Support the preparation and coordination of the yearly external audit,

- Ensure all accounting/financial Policies and Procedures are adopted in line with prevailing legislation.
jobs.requirements_raw:
- Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Accounting, or a related field.

- Up to 2 years of experience in a multinational company in accounting.

- Excellent analytical skills with a thorough knowledge of accounting principles to analyze financial reports.

- Knowledge of accounting procedures including IFRS standards.

- Knowledge of accounting standards and procedures

- Experience with general ledger functions

- Hands-on experience with accounting software packages (ie. Pantheon or SAP)

- MS Office tools, focus on Excel.

- Accuracy and attention to detail- aptitude for numbers and quantitative skills.

We are always looking for the best candidates, so if you think you would be a good fit even if you don't meet 100% of the requirements we would love to hear from you!

Individuals representing diverse profiles, encompassing various genders, ethnicities, and backgrounds, are less likely to apply for this role if they do not possess solid experience in 100% of these areas. Even if it seems you don't meet our musts don't let it stop you, we are all about finding the best talent out there! Skills can be learned, and embracing diversity is invaluable.

We believe driven talent deserves:

- 💪 Top-notch private health insurance to keep you at your peak.

- 🍔 Monthly Glovo meal benefit to satisfy your cravings!

- 🏊 Company sponsored Fitpass to keep you energized.

- 🏖️ The freedom to work from home two days a week, and the opportunity to work from anywhere for up to three weeks a year and personal days off.

- 👪 Enhanced paternity leave.

- 🧠 Online therapy and wellbeing benefits to ensure your mental well-being

So, ready to take the wheel and make this the ride of your life?

Delve into our culture by taking a peek at our Instagram and check out our Linkedin and website!

Glovo is transforming the way consumers access local goods, enabling anyone to get almost any product delivered in minutes. Our on-demand logistics connect customers with independent local couriers who acquire goods from any restaurant or store in a city, as well as deliver urgent packages for a variable fee. For additional information on Glovo, please visit https://about.glovoapp.com/

jobs.description:
foodpanda is part of the Delivery Hero Group, the world’s pioneering local delivery platform, our mission is to deliver an amazing experience—fast, easy, and to your door. We operate in around 65 countries worldwide. Headquartered in Berlin, Germany. Delivery Hero has been listed on the Frankfurt Stock Exchange since 2017 and is part of the MDAX stock market index.

The Head of Shops – Bangladesh is a senior leadership role responsible for shaping and executing the marketplace experience strategy for the Q-Commerce platform across the country. The position drives growth and operational excellence by leading a team of Strategic and Key Account Managers to deliver a seamless, high-quality experience for vendors, retail chains, and customers. This role plays a pivotal part in building a strong ecosystem of partners, driving efficiency across operations, and enabling data-driven decision-making to enhance commercial performance. By collaborating closely with cross-functional teams — including Operations, Commercial, and Product — the Head of Shops ensures strategic alignment and flawless execution of business priorities.

The role also champions customer-centric innovation and continuous improvement, designing scalable processes that reduce friction and elevate the overall vendor and customer experience. This position is key to strengthening foodpanda’s leadership in Bangladesh’s rapidly evolving Q-Commerce landscape and setting new benchmarks for marketplace excellence.

Responsibilities

- Provide strategic leadership across commercial and operational functions to ensure strong marketplace performance and sustainable business growth.

- Lead, mentor, and develop the team to deliver operational excellence, strengthen collaboration, and achieve business objectives.

- Define and execute a profitable business strategy that expands the vendor portfolio, deepens partnerships, and enhances customer value.

- Build and maintain long-term partnerships with major retail chains and independent stores through effective negotiation and relationship management.

- Identify market opportunities and develop initiatives that drive category growth and strengthen foodpanda’s position nationwide.

- Improve operational efficiency and scalability by implementing data-driven processes, automation, and best practices across the marketplace.

- Oversee and optimize key performance indicators related to growth, profitability, customer satisfaction, and team engagement.

- Collaborate with cross-functional teams — including Operations, Vendor Management, and Regional Leadership — to ensure strategic alignment and flawless execution.

- Lead transformative initiatives to address operational challenges, enhance service quality, and drive continuous improvement.

- Serve as the primary liaison for regional stakeholders, fostering collaboration and alignment to deliver a consistent, high-quality marketplace experience.
jobs.requirements_raw:
- Minimum 10–12 years of experience in e-commerce, retail or marketplace management, customer experience with proven leadership in managing large, cross-functional teams.

- Demonstrated success in driving commercial growth and operational excellence within fast-paced, multi-sided marketplace environments (vendors, customers, and delivery partners).

- Strong background in data-driven decision-making, with the ability to interpret key business metrics (e.g., growth, profitability, customer satisfaction) and translate insights into strategic actions.

- Proven expertise in account management, portfolio growth, and vendor relationship management, including experience negotiating and securing key partnerships with large retail chains and independent stores.

- Excellent stakeholder management and communication skills, capable of collaborating effectively with senior leadership, regional teams, and external partners.

- Demonstrated ability to lead transformation initiatives, optimize processes, and implement scalable, customer-centric solutions.

- Solid business and financial acumen, with experience in P&L management, strategic planning, and execution.

- Thrives in dynamic, fast-growing environments, balancing strategic vision with hands-on operational execution.

We operate in around 65 countries worldwide. Headquartered in Berlin, Germany. Delivery Hero has been listed on the Frankfurt Stock Exchange since 2017 and is part of the MDAX stock market index.

Job Ref ID: JR0085133

YOUR MISSION

Join us as a Senior Operations Analyst and become a key member of Glovo Georgia's Operations team! Couriers and partners are the backbone of our marketplace, and you'll be the one turning their data into decisions, owning the forecasting, planning, and performance analytics that keep supply running efficiently. This is a hands-on, high-ownership role: you'll build the tools and initiatives that directly shape how the market performs.

THE JOURNEY

- Own end-to-end supply forecasting and planning, including seasonal initiatives like winter planning, so the market is always resourced ahead of demand.

- Build and maintain the dashboards and automated reports (Looker/Tableau, SQL, Python, Apps Script) that the Operations team relies on daily: accurate, self-service, and hands-off.

- Take ownership of performance management across supply and partner KPIs: delivery time, prep time, and other metrics that shape the customer experience, digging into root causes and proposing fixes.

- Drive budget efficiency: understand how we spend on courier pay and operations, and find ways to improve performance without increasing cost.

- Design, launch, and measure experiments and improvement initiatives, translating open-ended business questions into structured, actionable analysis.

- Partner closely with the Supply Lead on fleet quality, engagement, and risk topics to keep data and on-the-ground courier strategy moving in the same direction.

- Collaborate cross-functionally with Finance, Commercial, Quick Commerce, Real Time Operations, and Global Ops to keep local execution aligned with the bigger picture.

- Present your findings and recommendations directly to senior leadership - your ideas will have real visibility and real impact.
jobs.requirements_raw:
WHAT YOU WILL BRING TO THE RIDE

- Hands-on experience with SQL and BI tools like Looker or Tableau: you've built dashboards a whole team relies on, not just personal reports.

- A genuine curiosity for data: you like digging past the surface number to find out why it moved, and you're comfortable owning KPIs end to end.

- Solid understanding of operational or marketplace dynamics: supply, logistics, delivery performance, or similar, so you know what a metric actually means for the business.

- The ability to turn a vague, open-ended business question into a clear plan of analysis, and to explain what you found to technical and non-technical audiences alike.

- Experience with Python and/or Google Apps Script to automate recurring analysis or reporting.

- A track record of owning a project or initiative from scoping to measuring impact, with minimal hand-holding.

- Comfort using AI tools to work faster, with good judgment on when to trust the output and when to double-check it.

- Fluent Georgian and English.

Individuals representing diverse profiles, and abilities, encompassing various genders, ethnicities, and backgrounds, are less likely to apply for this role if they do not possess solid experience in 100% of these areas. Even if it seems you don't meet our musts don't let it stop you, we are all about finding the best talent out there! Skills can be learned, and embracing diversity is invaluable.

We believe driven talent deserves:

-
💪 Top-notch private health insurance to keep you at your peak.

-
🍔 Monthly meal vouchers to satisfy your cravings!

-
💳 Discounts on transportation, food, and even kindergarten expenses.

-
🏖️ Extra time off, the freedom to work from home two days a week, and the opportunity to work from anywhere for up to three weeks a year!
