jobs.description:
Glovo is part of the Delivery Hero Group, the world’s pioneering local delivery platform, our mission is to deliver an amazing experience—fast, easy, and to your door. We operate in around 65 countries worldwide. Headquartered in Berlin, Germany. Delivery Hero has been listed on the Frankfurt Stock Exchange since 2017 and is part of the MDAX stock market index.

YOUR MISSION

As a Junior Analytics Engineer in our AI & Data Enablement team, you will be focused on building reliable data foundations and enabling the next generation of data products at Glovo.

This is an entry-level role for someone who wants to grow in Analytics Engineering while developing strong foundations in AI-enabled data work. This is not a pure AI Engineer role, but we are looking for someone who is already AI-savvy and has practical experience using AI tools to improve their work. We expect the candidate to understand both the value and the limitations of AI-generated outputs.

As part of DataX, you will help us make data more accessible, reliable and useful for business teams, while progressively contributing to initiatives involving AI-assisted workflows, data quality, documentation, automation support and GenAI-enabled data experiences.

You will work closely with Data Analysts, Product Managers, Business stakeholders and other Data teams to understand problems, build trusted data assets and support the responsible use of AI in data work.

THE JOURNEY

-
Build High-Impact Data Models: Design reliable datasets and data models that power critical business decisions across global teams.

-
Master Modern Analytics & SQL: Write clean, production-grade SQL transformations using industry best practices for version control, testing, and data quality.

-
Pioneer AI-Driven Engineering: Put your AI literacy to work on real-world Analytics Engineering initiatives, leveraging prompt design, context grounding, and responsible AI practices.

-
Solve Real Business Problems: Partner with cross-functional stakeholders to automate manual workflows, remove friction, and build smarter data products.

-
Fast-Track Your Growth: Work side-by-side with senior engineers in a supportive environment designed to help you rapidly evolve into an autonomous Analytics Engineer.
jobs.requirements_raw:
WHAT YOU WILL BRING TO THE RIDE

-
1–2 Years of Data Experience: Background in Analytics/Data Engineering, BI, Math, Computer Science, or a related field with strong analytical problem-solving skills.

-
Core Technical Toolkit: Solid SQL fundamentals (joins, aggregations, debugging), working knowledge of Python, and basic Git practices.

-
Data Modeling & Modern Stack: Familiarity with core modeling concepts (facts, dimensions, granularity) and an eagerness to work with tools like BigQuery, dbt, and Looker.

-
AI-First Mindset: Above-average literacy using GenAI for coding, analysis, or workflow automation; paired with a strong commitment to validation and responsible usage.

-
Collaborator & Communicator: High attention to detail, clear communication skills across technical and non-technical teams, and fluent English.

-
Glovo Culture Fit: A hands-on, proactive attitude with high energy, adaptability, and great team-player vibes.

NICE TO HAVE

-
Exposure to BigQuery, dbt, Looker or similar tools.

-
Experience using AI tools in more advanced ways, such as prompt iteration, code review support, data exploration, workflow automation or output evaluation.

-
Understanding of APIs, data pipelines or workflow automation concepts.

-
Exposure to process improvement, automation, process intelligence or operational analytics use cases.

-
Previous professional, internship, academic or personal project related to data, analytics or AI.

-
Interest in responsible AI, data governance, privacy and quality.

WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE

In your first months, success will mean:

-
You understand the main data assets, tools and workflows used by the team.

-
You can contribute to simple data transformations and documentation with guidance.

-
You can validate outputs and raise quality concerns when something does not look right.

-
You use AI-enabled tools responsibly to support your work, without blindly trusting the results.

-
You start connecting business problems with reliable data solutions.

-
You show curiosity, ownership and willingness to learn from feedback.

Over time, you will grow towards owning small data products independently and contributing to AI-enabled data initiatives with increasing autonomy.

IMPORTANT NOTE

This is not a pure AI Engineer role.

This is an Analytics Engineer I role within Data Enablement, with an expectation that the person will progressively develop AI competencies as part of the natural evolution of Analytics Engineering.

We believe AI will increasingly become part of how data teams work, but the foundation remains the same: trusted data, strong engineering practices, business understanding and responsible delivery.

We believe driven talent deserves:

-
🌟 An enticing equity plan (dependent on level) that lets you own a piece of the action.

-
💪 Top-notch private health insurance to keep you at your peak.

-
🍔 Monthly Glovo credit to satisfy your cravings!

-
💳 Discounts on transportation, food, and even kindergarten expenses.

-
🏊 Wellhub membership to keep you energised.

-
🏖️Flexible time off, the freedom to work from home two days a week, and the opportunity to work from anywhere for up to three weeks a year!

-
👪 Enhanced parental leave, and office-based nursery.

-
🧠 Online therapy and wellbeing benefits to ensure your mental well-being.

-
📚 An external learning budget to fuel your thirst for knowledge and personal growth.

Additional Information

Here at Glovo, we thrive on diversity, we believe it enhances our teams, products, and culture. We know that the best ideas come from a mashup of brilliant diverse minds. This is why we are committed to providing equal opportunities to talent from all backgrounds – all genders, racial/diverse backgrounds, abilities, ages, sexual orientations and all other unique characteristics that make you YOU. Translate repeatable analyst workflows into scalable AI tools. Act as a driver of AI adoption within the team, setting standards and upskilling junior analysts.

- Turn insights into impact!

- Looking for a career in data analytics? This could be the opportunity for you!

We operate in around 70 countries worldwide. Headquartered in Berlin, Germany. Delivery Hero has been listed on the Frankfurt Stock Exchange since 2017 and is part of the MDAX stock market index.

YOUR MISSION

As an Account Manager, you will be a Business Growth Catalyst. You will play a pivotal role in developing strategic partnerships to maximize revenue growth, improve partner profitability, and elevate the user experience. You will take full ownership of your portfolio, working autonomously while collaborating with cross-functional teams to deliver exceptional results.

THE JOURNEY

- Build and nurture strong, trust-based relationships with Glovo’s partners, focusing on long-term collaboration and business growth.

- Proactively identify partner needs, challenges, and opportunities, providing tailored solutions to enhance performance.

- Analyze partner data to develop and implement customized strategies for revenue growth and operational efficiency.

- Lead negotiations for contractual terms, including commissions, promotional campaigns, and exclusivity agreements.

- Collaborate with internal teams (marketing, operations, tech) to address challenges, drive initiatives, and optimize processes.

- Monitor and manage KPIs, such as GMV growth, operational performance, and user satisfaction, using reporting tools to track progress and make data-driven decisions.

- Design and execute Joint Business Plans (JBP) to align on shared goals and achieve measurable outcomes.

- Proactively engage churned or inactive partners, implementing strategies to re-engage and retain them.
jobs.requirements_raw:
WHAT YOU WILL BRING TO THE RIDE

- A Bachelor’s degree in Business Administration, Marketing, Economics, or a related field.

- Minimum of 3 years of experience in account management, business development, or a similar role in high-performance environments.

- Advanced English skills (written and spoken); additional language knowledge is a plus.

- Familiarity with CRM tools (e.g., Salesforce) and strong proficiency in Google Sheets, Excel, and data analysis platforms.

- Strong negotiation skills with a proven ability to close deals and drive value for all parties involved.

- An analytical, problem-solving mindset with the ability to interpret complex data and propose actionable strategies.

- Proactivity, adaptability, and resilience in a dynamic, fast-paced environment.

- Exceptional communication skills, with a persuasive and empathetic approach.

- A growth mindset and curiosity, with a passion for learning and finding innovative solutions.

- Ownership mentality, consistently delivering on objectives with autonomy and accountability.

Individuals representing diverse profiles, and abilities, encompassing various genders, ethnicities, and backgrounds, are less likely to apply for this role if they do not possess solid experience in 100% of these areas. Even if it seems you don't meet our musts don't let it stop you, we are all about finding the best talent out there! Skills can be learned, and embracing diversity is invaluable.

We believe driven talent deserves:

- 🌟 An enticing equity plan that lets you own a piece of the action.

- 💪 Top-notch private health insurance to keep you at your peak.

- 🍔 Monthly Glovo credit to satisfy your cravings!

- 💳 Discounts on transportation, food, and even kindergarten expenses.

- 🏊 Discounted gym memberships to keep you energized.

- 🏖️ Extra time off, the freedom to work from home two days a week, and the opportunity to work from anywhere for up to three weeks a year!

- 👪 Enhanced parental leave, and office-based nursery.

- 🧠 Online therapy and wellbeing benefits to ensure your mental well-being.

Here at Glovo, we thrive on diversity, we believe it enhances our teams, products, and culture. We know that the best ideas come from a mashup of brilliant diverse minds. This is why we are committed to providing equal opportunities to talent from all backgrounds - all genders, racial/diverse backgrounds, abilities, ages, sexual orientations and all other unique characteristics that make you YOU. We will encourage you to bring your authentic self to work, fostering an inclusive environment where everyone feels heard.

jobs.title: Analyst, Finance Performance - Bulgaria
jobs.description:
Job Ref ID: JR0076022

Glovo is part of the Delivery Hero Group, the world’s pioneering local delivery platform, our mission is to deliver an amazing experience—fast, easy, and to your door. We operate in around 70 countries worldwide. Headquartered in Berlin, Germany. Delivery Hero has been listed on the Frankfurt Stock Exchange since 2017 and is part of the MDAX stock market index.

Based in Sofia, you'll partner with Bulgaria's Head of Finance to keep the country's financial plan sharp and current; running the monthly re-forecasting cycle, owning the cash flow view, and keeping every department aligned on the numbers. Your rigor keeps the P&L honest and the plan actionable.

The Journey

- Best Estimate: Run the re-forecasting process; gather inputs, update models, flag deviations against budget.

- Profitability sessions: Support the recurrent sessions aligning every department on the plan and targets; spot problems early, propose data-backed plans, and drive follow-ups to closure.

- Strategic projects: Co-lead workstreams spanning finance, Ops, Commercial, Marketing, Legal, country, or regional teams.

- Insight & analysis: Curate reliable data, build business cases, and challenge P&Ls.

- Tooling: Maintain and enhance dashboards in BigQuery/Looker. Using AI tools (Gemini, ChatGPT, Claude, or similar) daily is required; not just to speed up analysis, but to build clearer frameworks and move faster. Real work with AI, not just occasional use.
jobs.requirements_raw:

- Problem solving: Break issues into components, define hypotheses, run analysis, and translate findings into practical recommendations.

- Curiosity & learning agility: Ask sharp questions, absorb feedback quickly, and grow fast.

- Prioritization & ownership: Own workstreams end-to-end, from analysis to follow-through, and hold yourself accountable to outcomes, not just outputs.

- Communication: Clear, structured storytelling, decision-ready one-pagers and crisp live readouts.

- Collaboration: You elevate teammates, share context, and document logic and assumptions for repeatability.

- Experience: 1–2 years in FP&A, strategy, controlling, consulting, or a fast-paced analytical role. Degree in Finance, Economics, Business, or related.

- Tools: BigQuery/Looker and daily AI tool use required; SAP, Navision, or Business Central — nice-to-have.

- Language: English required.

jobs.title: Head, CRM
jobs.description:
foodpanda is part of the Delivery Hero Group, the world’s pioneering local delivery platform, our mission is to deliver an amazing experience—fast, easy, and to your door. We operate in around 65 countries worldwide. Headquartered in Berlin, Germany. Delivery Hero has been listed on the Frankfurt Stock Exchange since 2017 and is part of the MDAX stock market index.

As Head of CRM, you will own the lifecycle vision, performance, and strategy across three brands and 16 markets, driving sustainable growth through best-in-class customer engagement across food delivery and quick commerce

You will design and lead the engagement and CRM communication playbook across both food delivery and quick commerce, covering all relevant customer touchpoints — from onboarding and activation through engagement, retention, and reactivation — with a clear objective of maximizing customer acquisition, improving retention, driving Pro subscription, and accelerating quick commerce adoption.

You will thrive in this role if you are commercially minded, analytically rigorous, and comfortable operating in complexity. Leading cross-functional initiatives with senior stakeholders across Growth, Commercial, Product, and Data, you will ensure CRM enhances user experience and delivers measurable business impact in a fast-moving, highly competitive marketplace.

You will lead a team of skilled lifecycle managers, CRM Ops. professionals, and other MarTech experts, driving strong alignment across all members to deliver consistent and coherent messaging for an exceptional customer experience.

Responsibilities:

- Own end-to-end CRM execution at scale, delivering accurate, customer-first lifecycle, fintech, and subscription communications across markets.

- Generate regular, actionable insights using dashboards and lead their implementation

- Identify, design, and deploy advanced AI solutions and intelligent agents to optimize CRM workflows, streamline technical operations, and drive better customer engagement

- Guide the analytics team in developing robust weekly and monthly reporting frameworks that measure and clearly demonstrate the effectiveness of CRM communications.

- Guarantee operational excellence across all CRM initiatives by establishing scalable processes, clear governance, performance KPIs, and continuous optimisation frameworks.

- Build and govern automation-first CRM systems, shifting markets from ad-hoc campaigns to scalable, always-on programs with measurable business impact.

- Lead technical CRM excellence, owning advanced targeting, exclusion logic, QA, and troubleshooting across Braze and dynamic content frameworks.

- Drive cross-functional delivery, translating strategy into executable CRM solutions with Product, Data, Engineering, and Local Markets.

- Set CRM governance and quality standards, ensuring zero-error execution, strong safeguards, and long-term operational resilience.
jobs.requirements_raw:
- Bachelor’s degree with strong academic performance

- > 10 Years of relevant experience in CRM, ecommerce or growth marketing related positions

- Excellent knowledge of Braze

- Obsessed about operational excellence

- Strong analytical skills with the ability to translate data into action

- Experienced in building and implementing AI agentic workflows to solve strategic business and technical issues

- Experience working cross-functionally with senior stakeholders

- Deep expertise in MarTech infrastructure and its direct influence on key commercial drivers like CAC and LTV; capable of converting intricate technical frameworks into measurable business results and directing technical resources toward high-ROI strategic initiatives

- High ownership mindset and comfort operating in ambiguous environments

- Strong prioritization skills and pragmatic 80/20 problem-solving approach

- Excellent written and verbal communication skills

Sales Operations Executive
jobs.description:
Tabsquare is part of the Delivery Hero Group, the world’s pioneering local delivery platform, our mission is to deliver an amazing experience—fast, easy, and to your door. We operate in over 70+ countries worldwide. Headquartered in Berlin, Germany. Delivery Hero has been listed on the Frankfurt Stock Exchange since 2017 and is part of the MDAX stock market index.

At TabSquare, we believe dining is more than food – it’s about connection, celebration, and community. Our mission is to reimagine the way people dine and restaurants grow.

We empower thousands of restaurants and small-medium businesses across 10+ APAC markets with AI-powered ordering and engagement tools that democratize digital growth and create memorable dining moments for millions of customers.

Learn more at www.tabsquare.ai

About the Role:

We are seeking a highly motivated Sales Operations Executive to support our dynamic sales team. Reporting to the Head of BD - This role is crucial in driving efficiency through data analysis, process optimization, and administrative support.

Ideal for individuals with a strong analytical mindset, attention to detail, and the ability to thrive in a fast-paced environment, this position offers excellent growth opportunities.

Key Responsibilities:

- Sales Enablement: Assist in creating and maintaining product demos for prospective clients. Manage a centralized repository of all sales demos for easy access and version control.

- Administrative Support: Manage sales documentation, including contracts, customer data files, and master client sheets. Ensure all sales-related administrative tasks are up-to-date and accurate.

- CRM Management: Populate inbound leads into the CRM system. Ensuring no potential opportunities are missed. Maintain accurate and organized CRM records.

- Data Analysis & Reporting: Extract, analyze, and prepare detailed reports from CRM tools to support management reviews. Monitor key sales metrics to identify trends, gaps, and areas for improvement.

- Sales Training & Onboarding: Assist in onboarding new sales team members by providing training on sales tools, CRM workflows, and internal processes.

- Ad-Hoc Support: Provide operational support to the sales leadership team as needed, contributing to strategic initiatives and special projects.
jobs.requirements_raw:
- 2-5 years in a similar Sales operations / sales administrator / data assistant role

- Analytical Skills: Proficiency in MS Excel or Google Sheets (dashboards, pivot tables, advanced formulas) for effective data analysis and visualization.

- Technical Proficiency: Basic knowledge of Google Workspace (Docs, Slides) and experience with CRM platforms such as Salesforce. Hubspot is ideal.

- CRM & Data Management: Strong understanding of CRM workflows, data management practices, and the ability to ensure data accuracy and consistency.

- Reporting & Dashboard Development: Ability to design innovative dashboards and reports, identifying new ways to improve data visualization and reporting processes.

- Detail-Oriented: Strong organizational skills with a keen eye for detail, ensuring high accuracy in data entry and administrative tasks.

- Adaptability: Ability to work independently in a fast-paced environment, managing multiple tasks and priorities effectively

jobs.title: (Senior) Specialist, Logistics Operations
jobs.description:
foodora is part of the Delivery Hero Group, the world’s pioneering local delivery platform, our mission is to deliver an amazing experience—fast, easy, and to your door. We operate in around 65 countries worldwide. Headquartered in Berlin, Germany. Delivery Hero has been listed on the Frankfurt Stock Exchange since 2017 and is part of the MDAX stock market index.

We are seeking a highly analytical and strategic (Senior) Specialist, Logistics Operations to join our regional logistics team. This position is based in Budapest, Prague, Vienna or Stockholm.

In this high-impact role, you will be a key driver of our logistics operations across the European region. You will blend deep data analysis with end-to-end market ownership to solve complex operational challenges.

You will act as the bridge between data-driven insights and on-the-ground execution. Your core focus will be driving daily operational excellence through precise rider staffing and forecasting within an ever changing climate. You will ensure our rider supply is perfectly aligned with customer demand to maintain high service levels while maximizing efficiency.

Key Responsibilities:

-
Forecasting & Daily Staffing: Take ownership of the daily demand planning and rider staffing process. You will analyze demand patterns, refine forecasting models, and execute shift planning to ensure optimal fleet coverage, balancing service level targets with cost efficiency.

-
Market Performance: Take full ownership of logistics performance for key EU markets. You will proactively monitor daily trends, diagnose operational issues, and implement data-backed solutions to improve delivery times and fleet efficiency.

-
Data Analysis & Insights: Dive deep into large, complex datasets to uncover actionable insights. Through analysis and visualisations you will create compelling strategic recommendations that directly influence our regional logistics strategy and tactical decisions.

-
Product Rollouts: Spearhead the operational launch of new logistics products and features in your markets. You will ensure seamless execution, perform impact analysis, and align local operations with central product teams.

-
Project Delivery: Manage high-impact regional projects focused on optimizing rider earning structures and overall logistics efficiency. You will work to standardize best practices and drive performance improvements across the region.

-
Collaborate for Impact: Act as a strategic partner to local logistics heads, working closely to translate regional strategies into local market wins.
jobs.requirements_raw:
-
Experience: 3-4 years of professional experience in high-growth tech, logistics, strategy consulting, or a similar dynamic environment.

-
Technical Fluency: You must have strong working experience with Excel, SQL, and Looker, including the creation of KPIs and definitions.

-
Education: University degree in STEM, Economics, Business, or a related quantitative field.

-
Analytical Mindset: You possess a hands-on mentality and logical thinking skills. You are capable of creating impact through data-driven decisions and are happy to question the status quo.

-
Communication: Exceptional English communication skills, both written and spoken. You can explain complex data concepts to non-technical stakeholders.

-
Ownership: Most importantly, you evidence strong traits of ownership, accountability, and a constant drive to improve operational outcomes.

-
A plus if familiar with modern productivity tools and use of AI/GPT assistants to improve efficiency.

jobs.description:
Glovo is part of the Delivery Hero Group, the world’s pioneering local delivery platform, our mission is to deliver an amazing experience—fast, easy, and to your door. We operate in around 70 countries worldwide. Headquartered in Berlin, Germany. Delivery Hero has been listed on the Frankfurt Stock Exchange since 2017 and is part of the MDAX stock market index.

Job Ref ID: JR0074606

Disclaimer: Only CVs in English will be considered.

As the Operational Compliance & Rider Operations Lead in Italy, your mission is to shape and safeguard Glovo's local operational framework while elevating the rider experience during a period of rapid growth. Reporting directly to the Head of Operations, you will take full ownership of navigating complex union relations, local regulatory compliance, and seamless rider support processes over the next 12–18 months. By driving high standards of operational compliance and efficiency, you will build a sustainable foundation for our delivery network across the market.

THE JOURNEY

- Lead & Support a High-Performing Team: Manage, mentor, and develop a team of 4 direct reports across rider acquisition, rider experience/support, billing & cash management, union relations, and legal/authorities support.

- Ensure 100% Operational & Legal Compliance: Define, deploy, and monitor robust local processes to guarantee strict compliance with Italian regulations, local laws, and authorities' guidelines.

- Manage Industrial & Union Relations: Establish and maintain a constructive, highly productive framework for union dialogue and external institutional relationships to navigate complex local frameworks smoothly.

- Optimize Rider Support & Billing Operations: Drive continuous improvement in rider experience, ensuring seamless onboarding, responsive support, and accurate, automated billing and cash management processes.

- Cross-Functional Collaboration: Partner closely with Global Operations Teams, Legal, and Finance departments to align local operations with global strategies and implement best practices.

- Drive Process Efficiency & Automation: Leverage operational data and analytical tools to streamline workflows, reduce friction in rider operations, and scale processes efficiently.
jobs.requirements_raw:
Must-Haves:

- People Leadership: Proven experience in managing, coaching, and developing direct reports (managing a team of 4+) with a strong track record of operational leadership.

- Analytical & Data-Driven Mindset: Hands-on proficiency with Excel and analytical platforms (e.g., Looker), combined with a mindset for process automation and data-informed decision-making.

- Project & Stakeholder Management: Strong ability to execute complex projects and navigate diverse internal/external relationships, from global cross-functional leadership to local authorities and external partners.

You will be directly responsible to build and maintain good relationships between our partners and our company. You will be generating growth with the most highly regarded restaurants in your cities through organizing marketing activities.

Establish excellent relationships with Glovo’s partners through consistent and proactive communication, identifying their needs and building engagement (Partner’s meetings and business reviews).

jobs.title: Sr. Specialist Demand Planning
jobs.description:
Talabat is part of the Delivery Hero Group, the world’s pioneering local delivery platform, our mission is to deliver an amazing experience—fast, easy, and to your door. We operate in around 65 countries worldwide. Headquartered in Berlin, Germany. Delivery Hero has been listed on the Frankfurt Stock Exchange since 2017 and is part of the MDAX stock market index.

Role Summary

We’re looking for a Demand Planner to join the team and focus on growing our own Grocery

Store “Talabat Mart”, which is the region’s first cloud store concept offering 30-minute delivery

of groceries at hypermarket prices. Launched in Kuwait and UAE, the service is

expanding fast to more countries.

WHAT’S ON YOUR PLATE?

- Responsible for ensuring we have the correct inventory at the stores (No OOS or OVS) by analyzing the current inventory status and updating the ordering parameters.

- Daily monitoring of stock movement, running report of daily inventory adjustment.

- Maintaining parameters of the replenishment model and making sure it is accurately input into the system, including lead times, reorder point, economic order quantities, suppliers minimum order quantities, etc.

- Preparing demand forecasts and initiating ordering to the stores and tracking receipt of such orders

- Managing the relevant inventory in coordination with the Category Managers

- Ensuring timely and accurate analysis and reporting of inventory and purchase forecast

- Dispatching orders to suppliers and ensuring proper tracking

- Liaising with suppliers for improving collaborative forecasting planning and replenishment

- Ensuring maintenance of appropriate and accurate records of in-stock and inventory position are kept
jobs.requirements_raw:
WHAT DID WE ORDER?

- You have at least 4+ years of experience in Demand Planning

- Strong knowledge of the fundamentals of demand planning, as well as the ability to work on demand forecasting from A-Z

- Experience in FMCG in demand planning and replenishment is a must

- Experience in Warehouse management or 3PL partner relation is a must

- Data and detail-oriented, and tech-savvy

- You are very detail-oriented, structured and know how to prioritize - you consider yourself as someone who delivers solutions and not bottlenecks to be solved.

- You are able to interact with senior-level executives and can manage the expectations of multiple stakeholders.

- You are someone energized by the unknown and look forward to learning each day on the job.

- You have excellent analytical and communication skills, and always like to be hands-on with several tools.

- Additionally, you have robust interpersonal and intercultural skills. You can inspire several teams and stakeholders to rally behind a mission.

- Language skills: Fluent English and Arabi

We are seeking a strategic and experienced leader to join our regional logistics team as the Head, Logistics Performance.

In this role, you will own the design, analysis, and optimization of logistics performance, rider payments, and incentive strategies across our 16 diverse markets. Managing a budget exceeding 1 billion EUR, your work will directly impact hundreds of thousands of riders. You will lead a multifaceted team focused on three core pillars: Rider Payments & Incentives, Business Planning, and RTO (Real Time Operations) Processes. This includes the design and deployment of live, ad hoc incentives to manage dynamic conditions like bad weather and sudden demand spikes.

You will act as the bridge between high level business goals and local operational execution, treating rider compensation and incentives as a critical operational lever. By optimizing core payment structures and dynamic incentive models, you will optimize fleet behavior, improve delivery times, and ensure rider availability matches customer demand while ensuring financial sustainability and long term fleet stability.

Key Responsibilities:

- Organizational Leadership & Development: Lead, mentor, and scale a high performing team of specialists and leads. Build a culture of analytical rigor, operational excellence, and continuous improvement

- Strategy & Business Planning: Lead continuous business planning and strategic guidance for the 17 markets. Partner with regional finance and local logistics teams to define long term strategies, defining both financial targets and operational targets (delivery time, efficiency and customer experience)

- Incentive Innovation & Deployment: Own the regional implementation of data science models, automated tools, and new pay components (such as dynamic pricing, surge models, and quest incentives). Direct the testing and rollout strategy to enhance fleet efficiency, engagement and order acceptance rates

- Process Improvement & Automation: Champion a culture of continuous operational improvement. Identify manual bottlenecks across workflows, and drive the adoption of internal automation, AI tools, and scalable systems to reduce manual workload and increase team efficiency

- Cross Functional Leadership: Act as the primary strategic partner to Local Logistics Leaders, Finance Leaders, and Product Managers. You will influence the long term development of rider incentive products and tools with the Central Product team, oversee testing, and turn complex data into clear strategic recommendations for senior leadership across the region

We are on the lookout for a Staff Product Designer to join the Order Tracking team on our journey to always deliver amazing experiences.

Imagine shaping how millions of users track their orders across 70+ countries, ensuring a seamless and delightful delivery experience.

This role is key to ensuring our customers enjoy a delightful order tracking experience across multiple brands, including Talabat, foodpanda, PedidosYa, Glovo, HungerStation, and the rest of the Delivery Hero group of consumer apps.

Our mission in the Customer Product Line design chapter in Logistics is to balance internal users and customers needs, business goals and feasibility in order to build the best-in-class solutions that drive positive business outcomes.

We have 3 principles as a design chapter here:

jobs.description:
Glovo is part of the Delivery Hero Group, the world’s pioneering local delivery platform, our mission is to deliver an amazing experience—fast, easy, and to your door. We operate in around 65 countries worldwide. Headquartered in Berlin, Germany. Delivery Hero has been listed on the Frankfurt Stock Exchange since 2017 and is part of the MDAX stock market index.

YOUR MISSION

Rider cost is one of the largest cost lines at Glovo with more than 20 markets with very different economics. Your mission is to own business performance for our largest and most strategic markets, and to make sure the Controlling system behind them holds: that we see risks and opportunities early, that targets get challenged rather than accepted, and that analysis turns into decisions our markets actually execute. You will do this as a senior individual contributor with genuine decision ownership, your job is not to report on performance, but to drive it.

THE JOURNEY

-
Own rider business performance across our whole 20+ markets. You are the senior counterpart to Country Heads of Operations, Finance and General Managers in our largest markets, challenging their targets, deviations and recovery plans without formal authority .Across the rest of the portfolio, you will steer the overall picture, coaching and stepping in when an issue becomes material, ambiguous or cross-market

-
Own the 360° view of our rider business KPIs. Cost is the headline, but it is only one dimension. You will own the full performance picture for our rider operations, cost per order and budget delivery alongside utilisation, delivery times, reassignments, supply health and rider experience, and you will be the person who holds the trade-offs between them. A market that hits its cost target by quietly degrading service has not hit its target, and it will be your job to say so. Over time, you become the person in the company who understands this business best.

-
Find the money, and decide where we look for it. Across a portfolio this size there is always more to investigate than there is capacity to investigate it. You will identify the highest-value risks and opportunities, drawing on experiments, competitor benchmarks and market trends as much as on our own numbers, decide where the organisation spends its analytical effort, and take deep dives all the way through to a decision, always with ROI in mind.

-
Own material deviations end to end: root cause, accountable owner, recovery plan and follow-through to closure. The goal is that nothing material surfaces for the first time at month close.

-
Lead the business narrative through our Best Estimate, budget and annual planning cycles, owning the material trade-offs and the senior decisions, and acting as the single reference point for FP&A and Finance leadership rather than one voice among several. Where the returns justify it, you make the case for additional investment to Glovo's executive leadership, controlling the budget is only half the job.

-
Raise the standard of the Controlling system itself, the standards, definitions, cadence, tooling usage and accountability that determine whether performance management is trustworthy. You will own this globally and set the standard the whole function works to, with a Controlling colleague covering our small and medium markets working with you on a dotted line. There are no direct reports today; as the function grows, there is a credible path to building a team around this scope.

-
Be the business challenger to our analytics team, who own the forecasting, target-setting engine, models and performance tooling behind many of these decisions. You will need to understand their work well enough to find its weaknesses and make it better, without trying to own it yourself.

-
Turn performance into decisions for senior leadership, VPs, Glovo leadership, Corporate Strategy and Delivery Hero counterparts, through short, honest, decision-oriented communication.
jobs.requirements_raw:
WHAT YOU WILL BRING TO THE RIDE

Must have

-
4–7+ years in Business Performance, Controlling, Strategy & Operations, FP&A, Consulting, Marketplace or Operations, including at least one role where you carried real accountability for a budget, a cost line or a market portfolio, not advisory work alone.

-
A genuine ownership mentality, and comfort operating without direct reports. You find the problem, form your own view, drive the decision, and make sure execution actually follows.

-
A track record of challenging and influencing stakeholders more senior than you, and getting them to move.

-
Strong analytical problem solving. You can decompose a performance problem yourself, interrogate someone else's model, and do the maths rather than wait for it.

-
Comfort with ambiguity, and the judgement to tell signal from noise and focus on what is material.

-
Advanced Excel / Google Sheets, high comfort with complex data, and fluent English.

-
Clear, direct communication. You lead with the conclusion and you say what you don't know.

-
Comfort using AI tools to accelerate your own analysis.

Nice to have

-
SQL or BI tools such as Looker at a confident user level, enough to answer your own first questions.

-
Financial fluency sufficient to hold your own with FP&A and Finance leadership on budgets, deviations and planning cycles.

-
Experience in marketplace, gig-economy, logistics or quick-commerce businesses.

-
Experience in a high-growth, multi-market or matrixed HQ-and-markets organisation.
